## Images move to the hatchward organization

The agent images are now published as `ghcr.io/hatchward/agent`. No image contents
change from v0.3.0 (contract 3); only the registry namespace and repository links do.

### Changed

- Images publish to `ghcr.io/hatchward/agent:{base,claude}` and the
  `:base-v0.4.0` / `:claude-v0.4.0` pins, for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64.
- The `org.opencontainers.image.source` label points at `hatchward/agent`, which
  links the package to this repository.
- The npm package name is `@hatchward/agent`; docs reference `hatchward/core`.

### Upgrade

Replace `ghcr.io/influpert/agent` with `ghcr.io/hatchward/agent` in the runner's
`runtime.agentImages` and image settings, and use `claude-v0.4.0`. The old
`ghcr.io/influpert` images are retired.
